title: Centre-out bar funnel with live counters
summary: Five stacked colour bars appear as hairlines on the centre axis, then widen symmetrically into a descending funnel while each big figure counts up and settles. A small header moves to the top as the bars arrive.
use_when: Showing three to five headline metrics as a ranking or funnel in one frame
A short silent social post or slide insert that ends on a readable stat poster
Comparing values that differ by orders of magnitude (width encodes rank, not scale)
A data beat inside a longer film where the last frame must hold

look.type_style: header: medium grotesk, sentence case, 2.6 % H, first word white, second word starts muted; figures: heavy condensed grotesk, 8 % H, near-black on the bar; labels: regular grotesk 2 % H, bottom-right of each bar

sfx.event: each bar starts to widen (centre-out order)
counters settle on their final values

structure.shot: dark flat frame: two-word header and corner mark at mid height, then five stacked colour bars widen into a centred funnel, each with a big figure and a small label
structure.camera: static: no frame-wide scale or pan in any cell; only elements move
structure.motion: 0.27-0.77 header fades in 15 fr (easings.outExpo, ±0.25 s), second word muted then white by 1.00; mark assembles 0.50-0.77; 1.27 a hairline of the middle bar appears at full height on the centre axis; 1.50 all five bars as slivers, middle widest, outer bars still lines (centre-out stagger ~4 fr, ±0.25 s); 1.50-3.00 widths grow symmetrically, easings.outExpo 45 fr (70 % at 2.00, 90 % at 2.27, 97 % at 2.50, ±0.25 s), no overshoot visible; 1.77-2.00 header slides off left and re-enters at top-left, fading in by 3.00 (±0.25 s); 1.77-3.00 figures count up on easings.outExpo 37 fr, last digit settles at 3.00; 3.00-4.00 hold 30 fr

params.brand: any brand.json: bg, fg, display font for the figures, text font for header and labels, mark for the corner
params.content.title: two-word header; first word bright, second word muted until it brightens
params.content.stats: 3-5 items {value, label, color}; ordered largest first so widths form a descending funnel
params.content.widths: bar width per row as a fraction of frame width (reference 0.92, 0.81, 0.70, 0.59, 0.48)
params.timing.barsAt: frame the first hairline appears (reference 38 at 30 fps)
params.aspect: 4:5 reference; 9:16 stretches bar height, 16:9 needs fewer rows or two columns

notes: Measured from 4 fps sheets and 1 fps full-res keyframes; no 30 fps strip, so stagger and easing are ±0.25 s. Bar width is rank, not proportional to value (the top value is ~7000x the bottom, widths differ by ~2x). Bars are centred on the frame axis, each with a thin white double rule on its top edge, 5 bars filling 11-97 % of H with ~1 % gaps. Bars appear first as full-height hairlines, then widen: height never animates. Counters start near their final values (only the last digits roll), so the figure is readable from the first frame it shows. Proposed terms (not in vocabulary): centre-out-widen, header-relocate. sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured (reference is silent).
